effectiveSet.newArea: Own package features, plus positive-revision foreign observed/planned geographic neighbours, confirmed occupies_parcel targets or explicit block members. A genuinely empty box has none.
effectiveSet.populatedArea: All positive-revision current features in the same area except IDs replaced by the package, then the package features, then recorded foreign neighbours. withNeighbours filters geometry-null source-only declarations and enforces the existing 2000-feature cap.
effectiveSet.secondPackageAfterDecisions1to3: No, if its effective set includes any recorded unqualified feature. createPackageCorrection carries the current positive revisions itself, so even a correction replacing every ID is gated. A geometrically unrelated genuinely empty area can still admit its first native package. No qualification is emitted by decisions 1-3.
